fields.value: Quickbus is Shuttle-UM's free service that transports you from your parking lot or the College Park Metro Station to Maryland Stadium. Quickbus operates from three hours prior to kickoff until one hour after the final whistle. All loops drop off and pick up at Cumberland Hall circle, which is a 7-minute (0.3 mile) walk to the stadium, and buses are available at this location during the game and after the game for your return trip. Buses on each loop are a mixture of ADA accessible and non-ADA accessible vehicles; paratransit service is offered to accommodate all guests.
